operations.details: Verified Ordnance Survey OSTN Update tool guidance.
OSTN02/OSGM02 coordinates not treated as current OSTN15/OSGM15 output.
OS Net v2001-to-v2009 shift kept separate from OSTN model update.
Verified OS coordinate transformation input/output formats.
Coordinate representation separated from coordinate-reference transformation.
Ellipsoid height and optional ODN height fields kept semantically distinct.
Formatting change rejected as any form of accuracy upgrade.
Model version and vertical-reference provenance remain mandatory.
No transformed or formatted coordinate used to invent parcel elevation.
Canonical manifest unchanged; serial publisher still required.
